summary: Created a 5-phase plan (6.5h) for the durable redeploy ledger: new gitignored specs/.orchestrator-deploy-ledger.json managed by scripts/lib/deploy-ledger-lib.sh (sha256 over source-store critical paths, verify outcome, timestamp, batch task numbers); checkpoint consults it before any expensive call with a hash skip (ordinary case, max-age cap) and an attributed-recency skip (self-modifying class: recent, shared task, delta within own cycle_modified_files), overridden by any deploy_pending batch task; deployed_critical_paths retained unchanged for its within-invocation role; Group 11 cases incl. a named self-modifying acceptance test; runtime-file registration; guardrails contract rewrite.
